name: Bluetooth Reconnaissance & Attacks
description: Bluetooth scanning reveals devices in the target environment — access control readers with Bluetooth admin interfaces, printers, computers, mobile devices, and IoT sensors. Some Bluetooth-enabled access control systems have administrative interfaces vulnerable to default credential attacks or protocol weaknesses. BLE scanning also reveals the density and type of connected devices, informing network segmentation intelligence.

blue.det: Bluetooth scanning visible in enterprise monitoring; unexpected BLE device appearing in scan results near access control readers.
blue.cm: Disable Bluetooth on access control readers where not required; use encrypted BLE; monitor for unusual Bluetooth activity; WIDS with Bluetooth scanning capability.
